business_summary: Far East Horizon Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides various financial services in Mainland China, Hong Kong, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Financial and advisory; and Industrial Operation segments. The company offers direct finance leasing; sale-leaseback; factoring; entrusted loans; operating lease and sale of related equipment and materials; engineering technical services; advisory and construction services. It is also involved in the import and export, sale and leasing of new and used equipment; and sales of equipment and spare parts, medical engineering, hospital and healthcare management, and education consulting and management services, as well as trades in tools and accessories machinery. In addition, the company engages in engineering and trading; operating leasing; supply chain management services; domestic freight forwarding; ecotechnology; administrative services, logistics services, equipment and machinery trading, building materials trading; and investment management. It serves healthcare, cultural and tourism, engineering construction, machinery, chemical and medicine, electronic information, public consuming, transportation and logistics, urban public utility, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Far Eastern Hong Xin Co., Limited and changed its name to Far East Horizon Limited in November 2010. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered Kowloon, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: Far East Horizon Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국 본토, 홍콩 및 국제적으로 다양한 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 재무 및 자문이라는 두 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 및 산업 운영 부문. 회사는 직접 금융리스를 제공합니다. 판매-임대; 인수분해; 위탁대출; 관련 장비 및 자재의 운영 임대 및 판매; 엔지니어링 기술 서비스; 자문 및 건설 서비스. 또한 신규 및 중고 장비의 수출입, 판매, 임대 업무에도 관여합니다. 장비 및 예비 부품 판매, 의료 공학, 병원 및 의료 관리, 교육 컨설팅 및 관리 서비스, 도구 및 액세서리 기계 거래 등을 포함합니다. 또한 회사는 엔지니어링 및 무역에 종사하고 있습니다. 운영리스; 공급망 관리 서비스; 국내 화물운송; 생태공학; 행정 서비스, 물류 서비스, 장비 및 기계 거래, 건축 자재 거래; 및 투자 관리. 의료, 문화 및 관광, 엔지니어링 건설, 기계, 화학 및 의학, 전자 정보, 공공 소비, 교통 및 물류 서비스를 제공합니다.
